description: Company enrichment from a website domain for German, Austrian and Swiss companies: reads the legally required imprint (Impressum) and returns the legal company name and legal form, postal address, phone, contact email, commercial register (HRB/HRA with court, Austrian FN, Swiss UID) and VAT ID, then checks the VAT ID live in EU VIES and matches the company in the Global LEI Index (LEI only on an exact name match). For lead enrichment, CRM cleanup, supplier onboarding and KYB. Finds the imprint link on the homepage, also on JavaScript-rendered sites. Names of natural persons (managing directors, owners) are left out on purpose. Send domain, e.g. zalando.de. Not charged when no imprint or no company data is found. Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"domain":"zalando.de"}.
